review:
Temple of Torment is a 14-payline Ancient Egypt slot about a clash between Ra and Anubis. Golden Scarab wilds that are part of a winning line expand up or down, depending on which god prevails, creating large wild areas; scarabs that don't expand count as single wilds.

When a scarab expands over a WILD symbol, a multiplier of up to 200x applies to the whole area, and several multipliers in one win are added together. Three to five FS symbols trigger the bonus games. Hacksaw lists 3/5 volatility, a 10,000x max win and RTP versions from 96.20% down to 88.24%.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 88.24% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
